title: Live Session: How Senior Risk Leaders Drive Growth
summary: Join our live session to learn how risk leaders at Elavon & Nexio turn risk management into a growth engine. Register & mark your calendar for Dec 8 at 1 PM ET.
body_markdown:
In 2026, risk leaders are operating in a complex, challenging environment.


Acquirers, PSPs, and fintech platforms naturally want aggressive revenue growth, but it


[comes at a cost](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2026/09/payment-processor-nuvei-must-implement-robust-merchant-screening-practices-pay-485-million-settle) . On one side, commercial teams demand frictionless merchant onboarding and rapid market expansion. On the other, threat vectors escalate, from AI-enabled fraud attacks to synthetic merchant profiles.


Historically, this dynamic meant that risk teams were tasked with slowing things down and saying "no." But that model doesn’t work in a hyper-competitive, fast-moving market. Risk leaders increasingly face expectations to step out of the back office and serve as core strategic partners. Now the task is to design risk frameworks that actively unlock growth


*and* maintain defensible risk exposure.


To unpack how top executives are navigating this transition, TrueBiz is hosting a live, 45-minute virtual panel discussion:


**Leading Risk in a Growth Business** .


[Register Now →](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1917950346227/WN_lTGakATcS42CMWttK1oeUg)


## **Key Discussion Themes**


This candid fireside chat brings together seasoned risk executives to discuss real-world strategies for evolving the risk function from operational control to strategic leadership:


-


**Building Influence and Commercial Alignment:** How to bridge the gap between sales and risk teams, negotiate commercial pressure effectively, and align risk strategy with overarching revenue goals.


-


**Designing Scalable Risk Infrastructure:** Strategies for future-proofing your risk program against shifting fraud tactics and regulatory moves, including how to leverage modern automation and tooling to scale without ballooning headcount.


-


**Elevating the Executive Narrative:** How to translate technical risk metrics into clear, nuanced discussions about risk appetite and trade-offs that land effectively with executive boards and C-suite leaders.


## **Featured Speakers**


-


**Tim Miller:** Senior Vice President of Global Credit and Risk,[Elavon](https://www.elavon.com/)


-


**Chad Nielson:** Chief Risk Officer,[Nexio](https://nex.io/)


-


**Danny Hakimian:** Founder and CEO, TrueBiz


## **Reserve Your Seat**


Whether you are leading a risk team at an acquirer, PayFac, or marketplace platform, looking to sharpen your function's commercial impact, this session will offer actionable insights from leaders who have built and scaled world-class programs.


-


**Date & Time:** Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET


-


**Format:** 45-minute live panel discussion with Q&A
